cards.title: Card 1: Start
cards.body: GestureForge shows one card at a time and advances only after a protected NEXT gesture.

cards.title: Card 2: Personal Setup
cards.body: The assignment prototype uses one local pilot profile and a small labelled gesture dataset.

cards.title: Card 3: Labels
cards.body: NEXT, PREVIOUS, BOOKMARK, and NEUTRAL are recognised labels; only NEXT controls this demo.

cards.title: Card 4: Neutral Arm
cards.body: A neutral hold is required before a command can arm the viewer.

cards.title: Card 5: Command Hold
cards.body: The controller requires a stable command hold before it creates a viewer event.

cards.title: Card 6: Repeat Protection
cards.body: One continuous hold produces one action and then latches until neutral is seen again.

cards.title: Card 7: Safe Preview
cards.body: PREVIOUS and BOOKMARK predictions can be shown in the interface without moving the deck.

cards.title: Card 8: Evidence
cards.body: The prototype records tests and experiment outputs so the report can separate evidence from plans.

cards.title: Card 9: Project Extension
cards.body: The final project can extend this viewer with all commands, profiles, deck loading, and persistence.

cards.title: Card 10: End
cards.body: The assignment deck stops at the final card instead of wrapping around.
